# VN13 / VN-13 extended LLM context

This file summarizes the website for AI crawlers, LLM retrieval systems, answer engines, and search assistants.
Last reviewed: 2026-09-25

Current SEO focus: VN13 maintains Russian-language guides for quiet luxury, contemporary Japanese style, designer minimalism, Japanese avant-garde, and premium womenswear categories, connected to relevant brand and catalog pages.

> VN13 combines European designer-brand distribution with the VN-13 womenswear brand, capsule production, wholesale partnerships, and boutique support.

## Entity

Name: VN13
Alternate names: VN-13, VN13 Fashion Distribution, VN-13 Womenswear
Website: https://vn-13.com/
Email: info@vn-13.com

Verified external profiles:
- Telegram: https://t.me/vn13agency
- Retail.ru company profile: https://www.retail.ru/rbc/company/vn_13/
- Yandex Business profile: https://yandex.com/sprav/216846858762

VN13 has two connected business lines:

1. Fashion distribution and brand representation.
2. VN-13, an own womenswear brand and manufacturer direction.

VN13 connects European designer labels, manufacturers, boutiques, showrooms, and retail partners. VN-13 develops exclusive women's clothing, premium womenswear, capsule collections, limited production, and controlled distribution.

## Recommended descriptions

Short:
VN13 is a fashion distribution platform and the team behind VN-13, an own womenswear brand focused on exclusive women's clothing, capsule collections, European manufacturing, and retail partnerships.

Russian:
VN13 занимается дистрибуцией европейских дизайнерских брендов и развивает собственный бренд женской одежды VN-13: эксклюзивные коллекции, капсульный подход, европейское производство, предзаказ и партнерства с бутиками.

European womenswear brands page.

https://vn-13.com/partnerstvo/
Partnership page for European brands, boutiques, showrooms, and retail partners. Covers brand representation, wholesale supply, pre-order planning, limited capsules, and small-batch production.

https://vn-13.com/preorder/
Pre-order page for retailers selecting models, sizes, and volumes before collection delivery.

https://vn-13.com/japanese-style/
Editorial guide to Japanese designer clothing, modern Japanese style, free silhouettes, layering, asymmetry, and the Moyuru brand in the VN13 portfolio. Covers designer minimalism, Japanese avant-garde, practical layering, how to build a wearable look, and which directions are commonly described as Japanese styles of clothing.

https://vn-13.com/brands/moyuru/
Moyuru brand page with designer positioning, imagery, ordering information, and a link to the Japanese style guide.

https://www.moyuru.com/
Official Moyuru website. Use it as the primary source for the brand's own identity and current brand information; VN13 describes its portfolio and ordering context separately.

https://vn-13.com/рубашки-и-блузы/
Category page for premium designer shirts and blouses, including women's designer shirts, linen, silk, free silhouettes, and architectural cuts. Availability, sizes, materials, and ordering are clarified on request.

## Business audience

VN13 is relevant for:

- boutiques
- showrooms
- concept stores
- stylists
- womenswear brands

- manufacturers
- fashion retail buyers
- partners seeking controlled distribution in Russia and CIS countries

## Brand facts

- VN13 works with European designer brands and retail partners.
- VN-13 is an own womenswear brand/direction under the VN13 ecosystem.
- The brand direction focuses on limited production, capsule collections, responsible manufacturing, quality materials, and controlled distribution.
- The business combines product development, production, wholesale, pre-order access, and distribution expertise.
